findings.mechanism: functools.lru_cache(maxsize=None) on the instance method category_totals. The cache is a single module-level (class-level function) dict keyed by (self, account, month). ReportService.handle creates a new ReportBuilder per request, so every key is new: 0 hits, and each entry strongly references its builder (which references the store, the three column lists and their padded strings) plus the result tuple. Nothing is ever evicted.
findings.cause: lru_cache on a method with unbounded size; self is part of the key and builders are per-request
findings.evidence: Ran load.run in 2000-request steps under tracemalloc with gc.collect between: traced heap 4606, 9222, 13766, 18454 KiB (~2.3 KiB/request, linear); cache_info hits=0, misses=currsize=1600/3200/4800/6400 (only summary requests reach it). cache_clear() drops the entries.
findings.discriminator: Fix: cache per-builder or on a module-level function keyed by (store, account, month) with a bounded maxsize, or drop the cache since builders are not reused.

findings.mechanism: ReportBuilder._columns lists are appended to on each render.
findings.evidence: render() clears every column at the start, and the builder is created per request. Rows per render are bounded at 28. Only retained at all via the lru_cache entry above.
findings.discriminator: Lists are cleared on every render and are bounded by rows_per_month; growth tracks cache entries, not the columns.

findings.evidence: served is a single int. LedgerStore holds only rows_per_month and regenerates rows on each fetch with no cache. Responses are not stored.
findings.discriminator: No collection grows in the service or store; the tracemalloc growth is fully explained by the lru_cache.
